headline: AES Beats Q3 Earnings Estimates by $0.33 with Strong Revenue
summary: AES reported quarterly earnings that beat analyst estimates by $0.33, while revenue also topped expectations.
why: Earnings reports provide crucial insights into the financial health and operational execution of major utility and power companies.

impacts.name: AES Corporation
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected earnings reports typically drive equity prices higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An earnings beat combined with revenue topping estimates signals stronger-than-anticipated profitability and operational performance, driving positive investor sentiment.
